Contact us

Our London office handles registration, technical, seafarer and general enquiries. For emergencies, we're available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

Office hours

Call the office Email the office 24/7 emergency

Emergencies only · 24/7, 365 days a year

Emergency? Call us any time

Urgent dispensations and exemptions are dealt with outside office hours, and the Principal Registrar can be contacted directly for help, advice and guidance.

+44 (0)7494 116754 Call the emergency line

Who do you need?

Contact the right team

Write to the team that handles your enquiry and it reaches the right person first time.

  • General enquiries

    Anything not covered below, or if you're not sure who to ask.

    office@barbadosmaritime.com

  • Registration

    Ship, yacht, bareboat and mortgage registration.

    registry@barbadosmaritime.com

  • Technical & operational support

    Surveys, inspections, statutory certificates and technical questions.

    ops@barbadosmaritime.com

  • Seafarer endorsements

    Endorsements and crew certification under the STCW Convention.

    stcw@barbadosmaritime.com

  • Accidents

    Reporting a marine casualty or incident. In an emergency, call the 24/7 line first.

    accidents@barbadosmaritime.com

  • Call the office

    Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 UK time.

    +44 (0)207 636 5739
